unlisted_practices: Adopt a robust AI governance framework and enterprise risk management system.
Use a hybrid human-in-the-loop approach for agentic AI in moderate- to high-risk healthcare settings.
Train clinicians in metacognitive thinking to understand cognitive biases when using AI.
Adopt AI and digital solutions that are patient-focused, cost-effective and cyber-safe.
Build a talent pipeline of data analysts and data scientists.
Build partnerships and collaboration with industry, institutions of higher learning and other stakeholders.
Adopt international AI standards such as ISO 42001, ISO 23894, ISO 25336 and ISO 24029.
Adopt a zero-trust security architecture and real-time threat detection for cybersecurity.
